name: Model Editor
description: Design data models visually — drag entities, draw relations, and edit Prisma schemas on a canvas. Opens .prisma files and exports JSON Schema, SQL DDL, Mermaid and more.

creators.label: Prisma schema
TypeSpec API
Arazzo workflow
creators.template:
arazzo: 1.0.1
info:
  title: My workflow
  version: 1.0.0
# Point sourceDescriptions at the OpenAPI your .tsp emits; x-typespec-source links
# back to the contract so the editor can trace steps → endpoints → entities.
x-typespec-source: ./main.tsp
sourceDescriptions:
  - name: api
    url: ./openapi.yaml
    type: openapi
workflows:
  - workflowId: myWorkflow
    summary: Describe what this flow does.
    steps:
      - stepId: firstStep
        description: Call an operation from the source above.
        operationId: listItems
        successCriteria:
          - condition: $statusCode == 200
        outputs:
          result: $response.body
    outputs:
      result: $steps.firstStep.outputs.result
